snippet.title: Deepest Fear - Exclusive Developer Interview - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
An exclusive interview with the creative director of Variable State, the team behind upcoming sci-fi horror FPS DEEPEST FEAR™, which takes place in a retro futuristic setting, and is a spiritual successor to games like System Shock and Prey (2017). We see more of the upcoming title, including how the real-time fluid simulation makes the water physics behave in a very realistic way. DEEPEST FEAR™ is coming exclusively to Steam - if you like what you see, head on over to Steam and Wishlist it now! 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #deepestfear
